value.rationale: The exact one-step randomized Kaczmarz sampling problem is the fundamental min-eigenvalue design of Dai et al.; a generically numerical SDP receives an explicit universally unique allocation for all admissible real one-hub equicorrelation parameters and integers at least three leaves. An active-mode phase switch at m(b-a²)=a(1-b), the rational dimension cutoff m=27 for a=3/10,b=1/10, and a discontinuous large-dimensional hub-probability boundary at b=a² give structural rather than merely numerical content. The fact is not presented as an improvement over different iterative methods.
